flint-and-steel.name: Flint and Steel
flint-and-steel.blurb:
Kereztesodes is a crossroads town, the last stop before the great northern frontier. Twenty years after the great Nagyhaborou, or war of annihilation, its people are trying simply to build lives. Three of those lives are that of Sinzer the carpenter, Mary the milkmaid, and Doron the old soldier. When Lady Matilda arrives with a company of armed soldiers, a small disagreement spirals into a burned inn and four dead bodies. Our protagonists run northeast, hoping to warn others and stop the campaign. 
As the journey brings them face to face with monstrous briarborn, magical mosswives, and the sweet music of oblivion, it forces each to face their own lies. Mary tells herself if she can just hold on tight enough, she won’t lose anyone else. Doron tells himself he can leave behind who he was before, that he can escape his life as a killer. Sinzer tells himself if he was just a little better, he could save everyone. They are all wrong.
